acs_and_behaviour.notes: I ran all ten requested gates and every one exited 0. style-test passed 21/0 and dressing-test 13/0 (Bow 7.2 %, Astern 5.5 %, cap 8 %). ui-theme-check ran strict with 0 leftovers across 57 contrast pairs. deck-assets-check passed (bridge_props 176,760 tris against the 180k cap, lift_head 4,752). deck-layout-eval reported the bridge ok. deck-layout-eval-test passed 22. ship-star-light-test passed 77, bridge-floor-test 14, ship-demo-lift-test 24, camera-forward-test 35. Not verifiable by me: AC4, AC9 and AC11 (golden, GPU/VRAM, full make test), which the report defers to the rig. AC9 is judged from the report alone: three runs gave p99 16.0, 16.2 and 30.1 ms. The target is claimed met on the best run, and the cold run fails it. That is honest but soft. AC12 (straight-edge share <= 0.10) is enforced by style-test, with a box scoring 0.586 as the negative control. The report's ship.glb figure (42,378 tris, 11 images) does not match the gate output (42,048 tris, 15 mats, 11 imgs); this looks like a stale number.

tests_and_gates.notes: The red-first and negative-control discipline is good: style-test, ui-theme-check, dressing-test and deck-assets-check each ship their own negative controls and they fire. Three of four drills were caught (see drills). Two gaps: clamp_deg is pinned only in test_dressing.gd, so the toon-card default and the dressing path are not independently guarded. style.shaped membership is not pinned, so a prop dropped from the list silently leaves AC12. The ship-star-light and ship-demo-lift logs end in Godot RID-leak ERROR lines at exit; those are harmless but noisy.

design_fidelity.notes: The implementation follows the design and the recorded decisions. The spire is the key, the toon shader's card mode avoids a second shader (D-106), the shape language (D-104) is measured, and the theme is on every panel with an explicit allow-list. The documented deviations are honest: 1.9 m fronds because of the 530 fade budget, foreground cards used in place of stanchions, and the Archive tomes joining the fade list. These are justified and listed in the report. Deductions: the below-rail canopies are weak scale cues, and the plan's named foreground props were swapped for fronds.

code_quality.notes: The work is well factored (ShipDressing, StapledonStyle, StapledonTheme, a pinned generator v4). The branch also merged in unrelated main work (captain anim, sound, telescope), which makes the diff noisy, although that is not the sprint's fault. Sprint JSON is incomplete: ST6 has passes/completed null and the sprint status is in_progress. That is expected before the evaluation, but it must be closed after it. -3 for those loose ends and the weak pins above.
